_comment: Hand-authored, action-first feature tips for approved Kiro Crew behaviors, including capabilities also covered by the documentation catalog. Each tip's body ends with the exact thing to do. An optional 'action' object ({kind:'route', label, route}) renders a one-click button that navigates to the exact settings page/control; tips whose feature has no navigable destination (a keyboard shortcut or a mid-turn composer control) omit 'action' and render body only. A curated tip that wants a 'learn more' doc link MUST use 'doc_link' (rendering-only), never 'doc': 'doc' is the tip's dismissal identity, and a curated tip claiming a catalog-owned doc there would suppress the catalog's own tip for that doc on dismissal. Loaded by kiro_crew.tips._load_curated_tips; the string fields are validated like generated tips, and 'action' is validated separately by _sanitize_tip_action (kind must be 'route'; route must be an internal path).

tips.title: Work two sessions side by side
tips.body: Run two chats at once. Turn on **Settings › Chat › Split View**, then press **⌘D** (**Ctrl+D**) to split the focused pane. Off by default.

tips.title: Jump anywhere with ⌘K
tips.body: Press **⌘K** (**Ctrl+K**) to open Search Everywhere — sessions, pages, skills, prompts, artifacts, settings, and runnable actions in one box. Prefer the IntelliJ-style double-tap **Shift**? Turn it on in **Settings › Shortcuts**.

tips.title: Hide the top bar and nav rail
tips.body: Press **⌥⇧M** (**Alt+Shift+M**) or click the **Focus mode** (full-screen icon) button in the top bar to hide the top bar and nav rail. Press **⌥⇧M** again to bring them back.

tips.title: Steer a running turn
tips.body: While the agent is working, open the send button's **▾** menu: **Steer** injects your message into the live turn right away; **Queue** runs it after the current turn finishes.

tips.title: Switch to CLI-style output
tips.body: Prefer terminal-style, line-by-line output over chat bubbles? Set **Settings › Display › Interface → CLI**. Applies to this browser.

tips.title: Cut session startup time
tips.body: Slow session starts? Run **kirocrew config set session.pool_size 2**.

tips.title: Use less memory with the MCP gateway
tips.body: Many sessions share MCP servers? Open **MCP Servers > Sharing > Servers**, turn on **Share** for a server or click **Enable all shareable**, then confirm any prompt that appears, and restart Crew if asked.

tips.title: Delegate independent work
tips.body: Independent tasks? Type **Run these tasks in parallel.** in chat.

tips.title: See local OpenTelemetry metrics
tips.body: Run `kirocrew config set telemetry.enabled true` to record OpenTelemetry metrics under `~/.kiro/crew/metrics`, viewable in the Telemetry panel. Stays on your machine — nothing is exported.

tips.title: Run the same check without the model
tips.body: Same check every time? Type **Schedule this as a script job** in chat. It runs without using the model.

tips.title: Manage worktrees and pods from the dashboard
tips.body: Building Kiro Crew itself? Enable the **Dev Fleet** app under **Apps → Installed → Show**, then open **Dev Fleet** to manage git worktrees and isolated test pods.

tips.title: Add new capabilities with Apps
tips.body: Need another capability? Open **Apps › Discover** to **Enable** a shipped app or **Install** an external app. After installing, enable it in **Library** and complete any trust review.

tips.title: See what each session is spending
tips.body: Open **Settings > Developer > System** for session resource use, or **Performance > Disk > Session storage** for disk use.

tips.title: Run commands without leaving the dashboard
tips.body: Click the **Terminal** icon in the sidebar for a tabbed shell that opens in the selected session's project directory; select any output and **Send to chat**. Pick your shell, font, and size in **Settings › Display**.

tips.title: Keep generated output
tips.body: Outside Incognito and Temporary chats, open **Artifacts > All** and click **Star document** beside a session document, or ask Crew: **Save this as an Artifact.**

tips.title: Use the dashboard in your language
tips.body: Switch the whole dashboard to another language in **Settings › Display › Language**, or leave it on **Auto** to follow your browser and OS.

tips.title: Turn repeated work into a skill
tips.body: Want Crew to suggest reusable Skills after sessions? Turn on **Auto-generate skills from sessions** under **Settings › Skills**.

tips.title: Use a different model for background work
tips.body: Need a different model for background work? Open **Settings › Chat › Model** and set **Background Model**.

tips.title: Let the agent use a real browser
tips.body: When browser access is available, ask Crew to open the page. Watch the live browser view in chat when **Show the live view in chat** is enabled under **Settings > Browser**.

tips.title: Let the agent drive a desktop app
tips.body: On a supported macOS or Windows host, when policy allows it, open **Settings > Computer Use** and turn on **Enable computer use** to let Crew drive a desktop app.

tips.title: Reach another machine's Kiro Crew
tips.body: Open **Settings > Remote Crew**; if disabled, click **Enable remote crew management** and restart Crew, then add the gateway.

tips.title: Store credentials in the encrypted vault
tips.body: For a command-based stdio MCP server, save the credential under **Settings > Secrets**, route the server through **MCP Management**, approve its launch, and restart Crew to use **secret://KEY** in its environment. HTTP/SSE servers cannot use this routing path.

tips.title: Schedule repeated work
tips.body: Repeating a check? Ask Crew: **Schedule this check.**

tips.title: Watch for a change
tips.body: Waiting for a change? In a Persistent chat, ask Crew: **Watch this and tell me when it changes.**

tips.title: Create a reusable workflow
tips.body: Repeatable stages? Ask Crew: **Turn these stages into a reusable workflow.**

tips.title: Save a durable preference
tips.body: Outside Incognito and Temporary chats, ask Crew: **Remember this preference for future sessions.**

tips.title: Create a reusable skill
tips.body: Repeating a process? Ask Crew: **Turn this process into a reusable skill.**

tips.title: Add an external tool
tips.body: Need another service? Open **MCP Servers** and click **Add Server**.

tips.title: Add a persistent project rule
tips.body: Repeating a project rule? Open **Customize › Steering** and add it to this project's workspace steering.

tips.title: Add recurring reference material
tips.body: Reuse this source often? Open **Customize > Knowledge**, choose **Sources**, then click **+ Add Source**.

tips.title: Automate a repeated event response
tips.body: Repeat a command when a session starts, a prompt is sent, a tool runs, or a turn ends? Add it under **Customize › Hooks**.

tips.title: Create a specialized agent
tips.body: Need the same setup for similar tasks? Create one under **Customize › Custom agents**.

tips.title: Create interactive output
tips.body: Need controls, forms, or a dashboard? Ask Crew: **Build this as an interactive widget.**

tips.title: Keep Crew available while away
tips.body: Need Kiro Crew while you're away? On Linux with systemd or macOS with launchd, run **kirocrew service install**.

tips.title: Continue from another interface
tips.body: Want Crew in a terminal or Slack? Click **Learn more** for setup.

tips.title: Choose an approval mode
tips.body: When the approval-mode picker is available, open it in the message box and choose an offered mode. **Normal**, **Reads**, and **Trust** set this chat's posture and can end an active app-wide override. **YOLO**, when offered, applies to every chat.

tips.title: See every keyboard shortcut
tips.body: Press **⌘/** (**Ctrl+/**) for the full shortcut list, searchable by name or by chord. **⌥K** (**Alt+K**) opens it too, and keeps working when shortcuts are switched off — so there is always a keyboard route back. Rebind anything in **Settings › Shortcuts**.
